description: Runs a Sergio card's move now, as the card's "Run this now" does. action_type is the card's action type (for example create_draft). A move that sends, moves money, opens to the public or grants access is refused with where the owner does it; a move that writes to an outside system (booking changes) is not lent to agents yet. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; the move keys on the card, so it never runs twice.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: run_suggestion_now
title: Run a Sergio card now
